title: ConfigApplyResult
description: JSON-encoded into CommandResult.detail. Overall status is done when every outcome is applied|unsupported|deferred (1.4: deliberately not applied now, with the reason; e.g. Wi-Fi off while Wi-Fi is the only network)|not-requested (1.7: the app doesn't request that permission), failed otherwise.

outcomes.description: keys: policies.<key>, kiosk, location, connectivity (1.5; unsupported for a mode the agent doesn't know), appPermissions.<package>.<permission> (1.7), appRestrictions.<package> (1.8: applied = set and read back; failed: app not installed, retried after app.install installs it; failed: <reason> when Android refuses, the read-back differs or a clear fails, retried; unsupported when the agent is not Device Owner or an entry has a value type it doesn't know, final, the package left alone). Outcome strings never carry a value.
